cohort: Adults diagnosed with CRC between 18 and 49 years of age from 1991 to 2017 in Sweden (cases) and up to 5 matched controls without CRC
finding: While cesarean delivery was not associated with early-onset CRC overall, females born by cesarean delivery had greater odds of the disease compared to those born vaginally.
mod_finding: This study specifically investigates birth by cesarean delivery as an exposure, making it central to the research.
